relations.subject: William Price
relations.role: assistant secretary and interpreter to the embassy
relations.evidence: In 1810, he was appointed assistant secretary and interpreter to the embassy of Sir Gore Ouseley to Persia which travelled there from 1811 to 1812.

relations.subject: William Price
relations.object: seminary of his friend, Alexander Humphreys, at Netherstone House, near Worcester
relations.evidence: On his return to England, Price wrote and taught oriental languages at the seminary of his friend, Alexander Humphreys, at Netherstone House, near Worcester.

relations.subject: William Price
relations.evidence: became a member of the Royal Asiatic Society of London

relations.subject: William Price
relations.evidence: became a member of the Royal Asiatic Society of London and the Asiatic Society of Calcutta.
